product_one_liner.value: HeartLegacy, now SalesMail, provides personalized video messaging and tour intelligence that help senior living and home-care sales teams build trust with families and book more tours and assessments.

pricing_page.notes: The pricing URL displays a demo-request form rather than pricing plans; no pricing link was found in the homepage navigation or footer.

named_customers.notes: Both organizations are named in customer testimonials.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index lists a marketing article about SalesMail's benefits, not qualifying engineering implementation posts.

public_docs.notes: A public knowledge base provides how-to videos, help articles, integration guidance and Sidekick guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Listed openings are Client Success Specialist, Product Manager and Demand Generation Specialist; none has a qualifying AI, ML or data-science title.

model_provider.value: Amazon Web Services (Amazon Transcribe); Anthropic (Claude API)
model_provider.notes: Sidekick uses Amazon Transcribe for speech transcription and Claude for summaries, coaching, scores and follow-up drafts.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 is listed as in progress, so it is excluded. No completed certification among the five requested frameworks is claimed.

last_funding.notes: The latest listed financing is a PPP debt loan, not an equity funding round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest listed financing is from May 2020, before the May 9, 2025 cutoff; no later round was identified.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: None of the three listed openings is an SDR, BDR or account executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: SalesMail launched Sidekick, its AI coaching and tour-intelligence platform, on September 16, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Corey DeGeorge's COO start is listed as November 2025, but the exact date relative to the November 9 cutoff could not be established. No other qualifying arrival or departure was verified.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The job posting explicitly identifies Zoho CRM for outbound tracking, attribution and revenue-system integration.
